    steps:
    - name: check out
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

      run: cmake --build ${{ github.workspace }}/build --config ${{ matrix.mode }}

name: Road Runner CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master", "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master", "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: road-runner

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repo
